taxonomy_note: Compatibility planning lens only, not a normative cross-domain mapping. Final root-cause taxonomy may differ or remain unassigned.
native_context: AWS IAM policy semantics; do not flatten into a generic allow/deny union

controls.boundary: AWS IAM effective permission and authority review — authoritative consumer
controls.source_trace: Collect the specified principal/action/resource/context, identity and resource policies, trust/delegation path and applicable session, boundary and organization constraints. Use policy/version provenance.
controls.controlled_verification: Resolve one concrete action against an owned resource using read-only policy analysis or a permitted simulator. Trace any role assumption separately from the assumed role's effective action. Compare an intended allowed action with the suspected excess grant and actual required conditions.
controls.false_positive_discriminator: A wildcard Allow is not effective permission by itself. Explicit denials, boundaries, organization policies and service-specific authorization semantics can change the result; a simulator may omit runtime context.
controls.remediation_acceptance: Narrow the evidenced effective permission or trust condition while preserving required workloads. Retest allowed operations and the original principal/action/resource tuple under the relevant constraints.

coverage_unit: One primary investigative assertion for this technique; not exhaustive coverage. Expand only for genuinely distinct policy/effect assertions in the actual assessment.
